items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I got a record date with Bobby Hackett's band which I wouldn't finish until 5:00.

ctx.x: Because none of the other guys that played that kind of music did use black musicians at all. That's why I brought it up thinking, you know, it was something.
Well, Eddie had a big band at one time that we played against when I was with Teddy Wilson's big band in New England. We watched 'em away. Bobby Hackett had a big band at one time too.
That I heard. It ran the gamut.
